contract:
Contract LibraryManagementSystemSystem::makeReservation(uid: String,barcode: String): Boolean {
	definition:
		u: User = User.allInstances()->any(x: User|x.UserID = uid),
		c: BookCopy = BookCopy.allInstances()->any(y: BookCopy|y.Barcode = barcode)
	precondition:
		User.allInstances()->one(x: User|x.UserID = uid) and
		BookCopy.allInstances()->one(y: BookCopy|y.Barcode = barcode and
		y.Status = CopyStatus::LOANED and
		y.IsReserved = false)
	postcondition:
		let r: Reserve in
		r.oclIsNew() and
		Reserve.allInstances()->includes(r) and
		r.ReserveDate = Today and
		r.IsReserveClosed = false and
		r.ReservedUser = u and
		r.ReservedCopy = c and
		c.IsReserved = true and
		u.ReservedBook->includes(r) and
		c.ReservationRecord->includes(r) and
		result = true
}
